gen-nosifer-fs-supreme: Sealed-flap mouths, widely tracked crayon marks: Nosifer, dark and commanding on the heading. Supreme holds a stretch of sans-serif copy, a heavy mid-strip, letters held open not shut.
gen-orbitron-gf-lexend-exa: Far-apart letters, large eyes, open apertures: Orbitron, minimal and precise. Lexend Exa stands under that spaced display as a sans-serif whose thickness never changes with direction.
gen-orbitron-gf-lexend-giga: Minimal spaced apertures, a large eye on every e: Orbitron. Orbitron does the short precise shout; Lexend Giga does the long plain sans line, flat and widely tracked.
gen-orbitron-gf-lexend-peta: Orbitron spreads letters far apart, open apertures, a large eye on every e. And Lexend Peta brings a plain sans under that spaced display, wide-mouthed c shapes, a big x-height.
gen-pirata-one-archivo: Gothic letters sitting nose to tail: Pirata One, a high lowercase zone, commanding on the heading. Archivo holds a stretch of sans-serif copy, outward curves all through.
gen-pirata-one-fs-asap: Letters sitting nose to tail mark Pirata One at once. Asap stands under that gothic strip as a sans-serif with open-arc c forms and almost cap-high bodies.
gen-pirata-one-fs-epilogue: Commanding nose-to-tail letters mark Pirata One, gothic and packed tight. Epilogue holds a stretch of plain sans, unclamped curves on a wire-like skeleton, high-bodied and stubby.
gen-shadows-into-light-inter: Crowded chalk-on-slate letters, casual pen-and-paper: Shadows Into Light, friendly and inviting. Inter, made large, still breathes through reed-cut counters while those crowded marks would smear shut.
gen-shadows-into-light-poppins: Friendly crowded chalk letters in Shadows Into Light, wide-mouthed rounds, casual pen-and-paper on a full slate. Poppins holds a stretch of sans-serif copy, rope-loose curves throughout.
gen-silkscreen-gf-lexend-giga: Lo-fi spaghetti letters with space you can feel: Silkscreen. Lexend Giga holds a stretch of plain sans, flat single-weight linework, tracking that opens each word fully.
gen-silkscreen-gf-lexend-peta: Retro spaghetti letters with space you can feel mark Silkscreen, lo-fi and spread out on the heading. Lexend Peta holds a stretch of plain sans, a wide-mouthed c.
gen-silkscreen-gf-lexend-tera: Lexend Tera draws a plotter-pen line with open-faced curves, letters standing like stepping stones, contemporary and clean. Silkscreen spreads spaghetti display above that sans-serif, space around every letter.
gen-titan-one-archivo: Towering midzone, one-width strokes, brush-lifted curve ends: Titan One, bold and playful. Archivo shows what lasts: that editorial plain sans under a playful, unshaded display heading.
gen-titan-one-work-sans: Work Sans keeps c tips from touching, joins matching the stems, a high waist throughout each word. Work Sans shows what lasts: that contemporary sans-serif under Titan One, a one-width midzone.
gen-unifrakturmaguntia-fs-epilogue: Epilogue feels unclamped and contemporary, a wire-like skeleton, high-bodied with stubby tips on every letter. UnifrakturMaguntia clusters gothic letters above; that plain sans holds a column.
